source_binding: Root verified all11 frozen product/preview artifact raw hashes before browser recheck.

Selecting historical version1 displayed its summary; leaving Saved history for Company and year explicitly changed status to Showing current synthetic setup version2.
Expiring the mock session during correction immediately removed all setup fields, save/correction controls and history; only the inactive-session message remained.
View-only member could not edit boundary inputs or save despite its client admin role.
During delayed load, switching from saved workspaceA to unsaved workspaceB and member actor retained B read-only state with no saved history; old A version2 state did not return.
limits: Same-authority token refresh is independently tested by the actual-component injected-hook harness; this browser preview has no token-refresh control.
Native client/API integration, release publication and hosted migration/deployment are separate evidence gates.
All methods remain held. No real company data, source release, calculations, invitations, customer readiness or assurance claim.
